MY LITTLE PET · TEJA PRIYAN

Install your little friend

Windows 10/11 · 64-bit

  1. Download Free 1.1.0 or Plus 1.6.0.
  2. Run the installer and choose your installation folder. Python is bundled.
  3. Open My Little Pet, name your owner and pet, and start playing. In Plus, press D in the room for the desktop companion.

These independent releases are unsigned. Windows may warn or block installation. Keep security enabled and contact support if you cannot install. Neither release needs a license key.

Existing Plus test saves remain in their original local save folder when you install Plus 1.6.0. Free and Plus keep separate progress.

Android & iPhone

  1. Open the mobile room online in your browser.
  2. Android: use Chrome’s Install app / Add to Home screen option. iPhone: use Safari’s Share → Add to Home Screen, and enable Open as Web App if shown.
  3. Open the new icon and enter your owner and pet names. Landscape gives a wider room; portrait also works.
  4. Wait for “Ready for offline visits” in Settings before going offline.

This is a web app, not an APK or an App Store package. Your pet stays inside the app; phones cannot use the Windows desktop overlay. Full-screen and orientation locking depend on your browser.

Keep your progress

On mobile, use Settings → Export backup before clearing browser data or changing devices. Restore that backup in the mobile room. Desktop and mobile progress do not sync. Uninstalling or clearing site data may remove local saves.
